help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

simulators.ensure.output_contract: Human confirmation that the named simulator scenario is launched or reconfigured.
simulators.ensure.prerequisites: Known SimEval/Chase scenario id; local simulator control plane reachable

simulators.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
simulators.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

simulators.status.output_contract: Whether SimEval currently has an online simulator deployment.
simulators.status.side_effects: Status and UI verification without auto-serve mutation (auto_serve=False)

vehicles.active.output_contract: Discovered vehicle endpoints; does not imply a deployed or running worker.
vehicles.active.prerequisites: Reachable Chase and/or Pi discovery URLs (defaults or flags)

vehicles.automation.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.automation.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.automation.restart.output_contract: First-frame verification after restart; Ready-for cue when the worker is healthy.
vehicles.automation.restart.prerequisites: Vehicle --id with a local deploy; existing worker optional
vehicles.automation.restart.side_effects: Stops then starts the worker; may open view; --observe-only avoids applied control

vehicles.automation.run.output_contract: Ready for: inspect perception and stop automation after first correlated publication.
vehicles.automation.run.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; staged perception (and memory when used); Chase/Pi endpoint
vehicles.automation.run.side_effects: Starts a worker; may open view and record; --observe-only avoids applied control

vehicles.automation.status.output_contract: Human worker line with captured/processed/skipped and stopped/running state.

vehicles.automation.stop.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; running or stale worker PID
vehicles.automation.stop.side_effects: Terminates automation worker PID and writes stopped state

vehicles.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.info.decision.output_contract: Staged decision engine id and stage schema.
vehicles.info.decision.prerequisites: Vehicle --id with a locally staged controller bundle

vehicles.info.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.info.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.info.memory.prerequisites: Vehicle --id with a locally staged controller bundle

vehicles.info.perception.output_contract: Staged perception schema and current published view URL.
vehicles.info.perception.prerequisites: Vehicle --id with a locally staged controller bundle

vehicles.memory.check.output_contract: Memory check: <vehicle_id> PASS or FAIL after present/dropout/expiry/reset.
vehicles.memory.check.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; live worker with staged memory and perception (Chase or Pi)
vehicles.memory.check.side_effects: Lifecycle gates present→dropout→expiry→reset; resets live memory; may --record

vehicles.memory.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.memory.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.memory.replay.output_contract: Deterministic: yes (two independent passes matched), or an explicit digest mismatch.
vehicles.memory.replay.prerequisites: Recorded observation sequence path; vehicle --id; staged or ephemeral memory implementation
vehicles.memory.replay.side_effects: Offline process-local replay; optional --record extract under runtime/

vehicles.memory.reset.output_contract: Keys: N -> 0 and Epoch: old -> new.
vehicles.memory.reset.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; live memory stage on Chase or PiCar

vehicles.operation.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.operation.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.operation.startup-check.output_contract: Per-command camera-change verification around bounded action pulses.
vehicles.operation.startup-check.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; live camera; vehicle that can accept action pulses (or --dry-run)
vehicles.operation.startup-check.side_effects: Default sends action pulses; --dry-run is separate non-default usage

vehicles.perception.apply.output_contract: Apply summary: failed frames, evidence kinds, representation health, latency, RSS.
vehicles.perception.apply.prerequisites: Recorded perception-run directory; packaged algorithm or candidate

vehicles.perception.candidates.output_contract: Packaged/lab candidate list and readiness (may diverge from compare).
vehicles.perception.candidates.prerequisites: Repository lab candidate registry; no live vehicle required
vehicles.perception.candidates.side_effects: Lists candidates; readiness may diverge from compare

vehicles.perception.check.output_contract: Physical-check placement scores and recorded run directory.
vehicles.perception.check.prerequisites: Vehicle --id or labeled physical-check frames; physical/lab capture path
vehicles.perception.check.side_effects: Captures or scores labeled physical-check frames; may write a record dir

vehicles.perception.compare.output_contract: Compact candidate comparison table over the same recorded frames.
vehicles.perception.compare.prerequisites: Recorded run directory with apply artifacts

vehicles.perception.disable.output_contract: Named plugin removed from the staged perception chain.
vehicles.perception.disable.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; plugin name; worker stop/start before the change is observable
vehicles.perception.disable.side_effects: Edits staged perception plugin chain; restart required to observe

vehicles.perception.enable.output_contract: Named plugin added to the staged perception chain.
vehicles.perception.enable.prerequisites: Vehicle --id; plugin name; worker stop/start before the change is observable
vehicles.perception.enable.side_effects: Edits staged perception plugin chain; restart required to observe

vehicles.perception.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.perception.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.perception.qualify.output_contract: First line Physical strategy qualification: promote_candidate or reject_keep_control.
vehicles.perception.qualify.prerequisites: Recorded physical-check run directory via required --from-check-run
vehicles.perception.qualify.side_effects: Offline common-frame compare; writes local qualify evidence by default

vehicles.perception.run.output_contract: Short live perception sequence summary; optional record directory path.
vehicles.perception.run.side_effects: Captures frames from the live worker; may write record dirs

vehicles.perception.setup.output_contract: Isolated perception candidate prepared (runtime state created).
vehicles.perception.setup.prerequisites: Candidate id; network if the candidate must be downloaded
vehicles.perception.setup.side_effects: Creates runtime state; may install/download dependencies

vehicles.perception.viability.output_contract: Onboard observation cadence and freshness measurement for a PiCar.
vehicles.perception.viability.prerequisites: Live PiCar --id with onboard observation publications
vehicles.perception.viability.side_effects: Samples live onboard cadence/freshness; may write a record dir

vehicles.status.output_contract: Simulator, vehicle, deployment, worker, and perception-view state.

vehicles.stream.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.stream.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.stream.memory.output_contract: Key→value memory ledger (terminal and local map page).
vehicles.stream.memory.side_effects: Read-only live memory inspection; may open local map page

vehicles.stream.perception.output_contract: Updating terminal view of the latest perception publication.
vehicles.stream.perception.side_effects: Read-only live perception stream in the terminal

vehicles.update.autonomy.output_contract: Autonomy controller deploy/sync result (or dry-run plan).
vehicles.update.autonomy.side_effects: Deploys a versioned autonomy release to a physical host; --dry-run skips mutation

vehicles.update.core.output_contract: Donkey harness sync and boot-service install result (or dry-run plan).
vehicles.update.core.side_effects: Syncs harness and may install a boot service; --dry-run skips mutation

vehicles.update.decision.output_contract: Staged decision engine identity in the local controller bundle.
vehicles.update.decision.side_effects: Stages decision engine selection on the vehicle bundle

vehicles.update.help.output_contract: Help text only; next-leaf and flag discovery.
vehicles.update.help.side_effects: Prints help text only; no runtime mutation

vehicles.update.memory.output_contract: Staged memory implementation identity in the local controller bundle.
vehicles.update.memory.side_effects: Stages memory implementation/activation on the vehicle bundle

vehicles.update.perception.output_contract: Staged perception algorithm or candidate identity in the local bundle.
vehicles.update.perception.side_effects: Stages perception algorithm/activation on the vehicle bundle
